package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestReconcilePlannerLearningPathItemsPreservesMonotonicProgress(t *testing.T) {
	current := planningTestPath([]LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "already_ready"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemInProgress, ReasonCode: "student_started", Targets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.old", Version: "v1"}}},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Position: 2, Status: LearningPathItemCompleted, ReasonCode: "course_completed"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Position: 3, Status: LearningPathItemSkippedMastered, ReasonCode: "mastery_no_gap"},
	})
	desired := []LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh", Targets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.new", Version: "v2"}}},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Position: 2, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Position: 3, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "planner_refresh"},
	}
	items, changed, err := ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(current, desired)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reconcile items: %v", err)
	}
	want := []LearningPathItemStatus{
		LearningPathItemReady, LearningPathItemInProgress, LearningPathItemCompleted, LearningPathItemSkippedMastered,
	}
	for index := range want {
		if items[index].Status != want[index] || items[index].ReasonCode != current.Items[index].ReasonCode {
			t.Fatalf("item %d regressed: got=%+v want_status=%s", index, items[index], want[index])
		}
	}
	if changed {
		t.Fatal("planner-only status regressions should reconcile to a no-op")
	}
	if len(items[1].Targets) != 1 || items[1].Targets[0].Key != "go.old" || items[1].Targets[0].Version != "v1" {
		t.Fatalf("progressed item target drifted: %+v", items[1].Targets)
	}
}

func TestReconcilePlannerLearningPathItemsDoesNotCreateSecondReadyItem(t *testing.T) {
	current := planningTestPath([]LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "already_ready"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "later"},
	})
	items, _, err := ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(current, []LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "refresh"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "new_ready"},
	})
	if err != nil || items[0].Status != LearningPathItemReady || items[1].Status != LearningPathItemPlanned {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected READY reconciliation: items=%+v err=%v", items, err)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeLearningPathPlanningCommandRejectsPlannerProgressMutation(t *testing.T) {
	command := planningTestCommand()
	command.DesiredItems[0].Status = LearningPathItemCompleted
	if _, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningCommand(command); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected Planner COMPLETED status to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestApplyPlannerLearningPathReplanReplacesDesiredCourseIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	current := planningTestPath(planningTestCommand().DesiredItems)
	command := planningTestCommand()
	command.CourseID = "ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff"
	command.CourseFingerprint = "fingerprint-v2"
	command.DesiredItems = []LearningPathItem{{
		ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		Targets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}},
	}}
	updated, changed, err := ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(current, command)
	if err != nil || !changed || updated.ID != current.ID || updated.CourseID != command.CourseID ||
		updated.CourseFingerprint != command.CourseFingerprint || updated.CurriculumRevision != command.CourseFingerprint ||
		updated.Version != current.Version+1 || updated.Items[0].ReferenceID == current.Items[0].ReferenceID {
		t.Fatalf("replace desired Course identity: updated=%+v changed=%v err=%v", updated, changed, err)
	}
}

func TestApplyPlannerLearningPathReplanRejectsStalePathVersion(t *testing.T) {
	current := planningTestPath(planningTestCommand().DesiredItems)
	command := planningTestCommand()
	command.ExpectedPathVersion = current.Version + 1
	if _, _, err := ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(current, command); !errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("stale replan error=%v, want conflict", err)
	}
}

func TestApplyPlannerLearningPathReplanKeepsSameCourseNoOpStable(t *testing.T) {
	command := planningTestCommand()
	current := planningTestPath(command.DesiredItems)
	current.PlannerPolicyVersion = command.PlannerPolicyVersion
	current.ReasonCode = command.ReasonCode
	current.ReasonSummary = command.ReasonSummary
	current, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(current)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize current: %v", err)
	}
	updated, changed, err := ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(current, command)
	if err != nil || changed || !reflect.DeepEqual(updated, current) {
		t.Fatalf("same-Course no-op: updated=%+v changed=%v err=%v", updated, changed, err)
	}
}

func planningTestPath(items []LearningPathItem) StudentLearningPath {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	return StudentLearningPath{
		ID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", StudentID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb",
		CourseID: "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CurriculumRevision: "fingerprint-v1", PolicyVersion: LearningPathPolicyVersion,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Initial route",
		Status: LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, Items: items, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}
}

func planningTestCommand() LearningPathPlanningCommand {
	return LearningPathPlanningCommand{
		Schema: LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, Kind: LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan,
		StudentID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", LearningPathID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
		PlanningRequestID: "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd", IdempotencyKey: "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee",
		CourseID: "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc", GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v2", ReasonCode: "replan", ReasonSummary: "Refresh route", ExpectedPathVersion: 1,
		DesiredItems: []LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "refresh",
		}},
		RequestHash: strings.Repeat("1", 64), OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 11, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func TestApplyPlannerLearningPathReplanKeepsPersistedLegacyNoOpStable(t *testing.T) {
	for _, explicitID := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "omitted_desired_id"
		if explicitID {
			name = "explicit_desired_id"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			command := planningTestCommand()
			current := planningTestPath(append([]LearningPathItem(nil), command.DesiredItems...))
			current.PlannerPolicyVersion = command.PlannerPolicyVersion
			current.ReasonCode = command.ReasonCode
			current.ReasonSummary = command.ReasonSummary
			// Stored legacy items have stable Student IDs and JSON [] requirements.
			current.Items[0].ID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
			current.Items[0].FrozenRequirements = []LessonRequirement{}
			if explicitID {
				command.DesiredItems[0].ID = current.Items[0].ID
			}
			current, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(current)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("normalize current: %v", err)
			}
			updated, changed, err := ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(current, command)
			if err != nil || changed || !reflect.DeepEqual(updated, current) {
				t.Fatalf("persisted same-Course no-op: updated=%+v changed=%v err=%v", updated, changed, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReconcilePlannerLearningPathItemsPreservesSuppliedAndFrozenIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("explicit_legacy_id_is_not_overwritten", func(t *testing.T) {
		command := planningTestCommand()
		current := planningTestPath(append([]LearningPathItem(nil), command.DesiredItems...))
		current.Items[0].ID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
		command.DesiredItems[0].ID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
		items, changed, err := ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(current, command.DesiredItems)
		if err != nil || !changed || items[0].ID != command.DesiredItems[0].ID {
			t.Fatalf("explicit desired identity was overwritten: items=%+v changed=%v err=%v", items, changed, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("bound_assignment_keeps_frozen_requirements_and_content", func(t *testing.T) {
		item := completionItem("theory_acknowledged")
		item.LessonContent = []byte(`{"title":"frozen"}`)
		current, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(planningTestPath([]LearningPathItem{item}))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("normalize bound current: %v", err)
		}
		desired := item
		desired.FrozenRequirements = append([]LessonRequirement(nil), item.FrozenRequirements...)
		desired.FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = true
		desired.LessonContent = []byte(`{"title":"changed"}`)
		items, changed, err := ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(current, []LearningPathItem{desired})
		if err != nil || changed || !reflect.DeepEqual(items[0], current.Items[0]) {
			t.Fatalf("bound assignment drifted: items=%+v changed=%v err=%v", items, changed, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("bound_revision_drift_is_rejected", func(t *testing.T) {
		item := completionItem("theory_acknowledged")
		current := planningTestPath([]LearningPathItem{item})
		desired := item
		desired.LessonRevisionID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
		if _, _, err := ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(current, []LearningPathItem{desired}); !errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("bound revision drift error=%v, want conflict", err)
		}
	})
}

func TestReplanRejectsCompletedHistoryStructuralChanges(t *testing.T) {
	for _, change := range []string{"omit", "move", "identity", "reference", "revision"} {
		t.Run(change, func(t *testing.T) {
			completed := completionItem("theory_acknowledged")
			completed.Status = LearningPathItemCompleted
			completed.FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = true
			later := planningTestCommand().DesiredItems[0]
			later.Position = 1
			current := planningTestPath([]LearningPathItem{completed, later})
			desired := []LearningPathItem{completed, later}
			desired[0].Status = LearningPathItemPlanned
			switch change {
			case "omit":
				desired = desired[1:]
				desired[0].Position = 0
			case "move":
				desired[0], desired[1] = desired[1], desired[0]
				desired[0].Position = 0
				desired[1].Position = 1
			case "identity":
				desired[0].ID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
			case "reference":
				desired[0].ReferenceID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
			case "revision":
				desired[0].LessonRevisionID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
			}
			command := planningTestCommand()
			command.DesiredItems = desired
			if _, _, err := ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(current, command); !errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("%s accepted: %v", change, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReplanPreservesCompletedHistoryAgainstSameRankDesiredDrift(t *testing.T) {
	item := completionItem("theory_acknowledged")
	item.Status = LearningPathItemCompleted
	item.FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = true
	item.Targets = []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.old", Version: "v1"}}
	current, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(planningTestPath([]LearningPathItem{item}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	desired := item
	desired.Status = LearningPathItemReady
	desired.ReasonCode = "changed"
	desired.Targets = []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.new", Version: "v2"}}
	desired.FrozenRequirements = nil
	desired.LessonContent = []byte(`{"title":"changed"}`)
	items, changed, err := ReconcilePlannerLearningPathItems(current, []LearningPathItem{desired})
	if err != nil || changed || !reflect.DeepEqual(items[0], current.Items[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("history drift: %+v changed=%v err=%v", items, changed, err)
	}
}

func TestReplanWaitsForActiveBoundaryButAllowsExactNoOp(t *testing.T) {
	command := planningTestCommand()
	current := planningTestPath(append([]LearningPathItem(nil), command.DesiredItems...))
	current.Items[0].Status = LearningPathItemInProgress
	current.PlannerPolicyVersion = command.PlannerPolicyVersion
	current.ReasonCode = command.ReasonCode
	current.ReasonSummary = command.ReasonSummary
	current, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(current)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if updated, changed, err := ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(current, command); err != nil || changed || !reflect.DeepEqual(updated, current) {
		t.Fatalf("exact active no-op rejected: changed=%v err=%v", changed, err)
	}
	for _, change := range []string{"omit_active", "future_insert", "course", "fingerprint"} {
		t.Run(change, func(t *testing.T) {
			c := planningTestCommand()
			switch change {
			case "omit_active":
				c.DesiredItems[0].ReferenceID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
			case "future_insert":
				next := c.DesiredItems[0]
				next.ReferenceID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
				next.Position = 1
				c.DesiredItems = append(c.DesiredItems, next)
			case "course":
				c.CourseID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
			case "fingerprint":
				c.CourseFingerprint = "changed"
			}
			if _, _, err := ApplyPlannerLearningPathReplan(current, c); !errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("%s accepted: %v", change, err)
			}
		})
	}
}
